_comment: Default wording for the tunable thresholds of the Signal guide (how many actions are watched, how many members go along, how long the decision takes). This file is public: it holds example wording only. A real group chooses its own values and does not publish them. Pages use {{ default("id") }}; routes.json uses [[id]]. A capital first letter (default("Actions"), [[Actions]]) capitalises the result.

example.fr: par exemple, deux actions et 48 heures pour entrer dans le groupe de confiance, où rien de sensible ne s'écrit
example.en: for example, two actions and 48 hours to join the trusted group, where nothing sensitive is written
